title: Independently check #4279's depth-four count vectors for m = 2..5: P(m) and the dominance law hold in the box n <= 3m (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

This adds `research/depth4-count-vectors-check/`, an independent check of #4279 (Nick Petalas). #4279 classifies the call-count vectors of the unsigned depth-four dirty chain connector at `m = 2..5`: a vector is attained, for any nonzero `c`, exactly when its entries are multiples of `m` and it dominates a member of `P(m)`. The bills follow:

| m | cheapest bill |
| --- | --- |
| 2 | `2S + 2(p2+p3)` |
| 3 | `3S + 6·min(p2,p3)` |
| 4 | `4S + 4·min(p2,p3)` |
| 5 | `5S + 5·min(p)` |

#4279's completeness step is a finite reduction checked only by its own search.

**Claim type: an independent exhaustive finite computation in the box of entries `≤ 3m`. No new κ.**

## Result

For every `m = 2..5` and every residue `c`, within the box:

- the minimal attained vectors are exactly #4279's `P(m)`;
- the attained set is exactly the multiples of `m` dominating `P(m)`: 36, 54, 72 and 80 vectors per residue;
- `P(m)` does not depend on `c`;
- the four bill formulas equal `min over P(m)` at 2,000 random rational prices, giving 12, 18, 20 and 25 at unit prices.

## Method and independence

The method is different from #4279's middle-letter reduction:

- **Reachable sets.** `R(n)`, the products of words with exact counts `n`, satisfies `R(n) = ⋃_l g_l·R(n − e_l)` in the lower unitriangular group mod `m`.
- **Coset compression.** The adjacent entries of `R(n)` are `n_l mod m`, so each set lives on six coordinates.
- **Implementations.** Python, standard library, reruns `m = 2, 3` in about 19 seconds. `countdp.c` covers `m = 2..5`; `m = 5` takes 21 s and about 128 MB. Its recorded runs are bound to the source by SHA256, agree with Python at `m = 2, 3`, and are local evidence that CI does not recompile.

Nothing is imported from #4279.

```text
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/depth4-count-vectors-check --check-only
  PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/depth4-count-vectors-check
  PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/depth4-count-vectors-check outcome=completed
```

Head: `2dce07ef435e776889e23f1f1f58afaa989611fc`.

## Not covered

- Vectors outside the box. #4279's reduction covers every length and is not re-derived here.
- `m ≥ 6`, where #4279 cites #4263; #4343 checks #4263's words separately.

## Task and overlap

- Card: `connector-alphabet-change`, refined, priority revision 7.
- Base: canonical main `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`.
- #4279 has no comments or outside check.
